guide: Open Start and type your company name and your own limits in the yellow cells: days before departure for documents, itinerary, vouchers and briefing, passport months, support hours and your time zone.
Check Team, Clients, Suppliers and Trips. They hold the people, clients, suppliers and trips that every other sheet looks up.

Fill Travel Requirements with your own planning notes for each destination: passport months, days to allow for a visa, health and insurance notes. Always check the destination's current rules from an official source.
Log every booking on Bookings and every document on Travel Documents. Days to the deadline, days early and the risk check fill in; Departures by Week shows which weeks are at risk.
Record each traveller on Passport and Visa Checks and each policy on Insurance Policies. Months valid after the return, the apply-by date and cover gaps are checked for you.
Build the plan on Itinerary Days and track every voucher on Vouchers and E-tickets until it reaches the client.
Keep Pre-departure Tasks, Pre-departure Briefings, Special Requests and Emergency Contacts up to date as a trip gets close.
Use Support Log and Disruptions and Rebookings while a trip is in progress, and Post-trip Tasks when the client is home.
Keep Packing and Weather Notes for the places you sell most and check a current forecast before you send one.
Use the 14 calculators for deadlines, passports, visas, itineraries, readiness, insurance, time zones, connections, checklists, requests, disruptions, packing, leave and a what-if.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to send a text with the details already written in.
Read the Departure Dashboard and Charts every week: departures, documents missing, passports, visas, vouchers, requests, support cases and ready rate.

listing.title: Travel Agent Itineraries, Documents and Requirements Excel Template: Document Deadlines, Passport Check, Vouchers, Insurance, Support Log
listing.headline: Send every traveller off ready, with nothing missing
listing.description:
Run the readiness side of an independent travel agent or travel advisor business in one Excel workbook. Travel Documents lists every document a client must send, with its due date, days to the deadline, days early and a risk check that turns urgent when departure is close. Passport and Visa Checks works out the months a passport is valid after the return, the last safe expiry date and the date a visa should be applied for.

Itinerary Days holds the day-by-day plan with a date, weekday, place, activity and the booking behind each day. Bookings, Vouchers and E-tickets show which vouchers went out and how many days before travel. Insurance Policies compares the cover dates with the trip dates and flags a gap at the start or the end. Special Requests tracks every room, meal, access and celebration request with the supplier asked, the answer and a chase check.

Pre-departure Tasks, Pre-departure Briefings, Emergency Contacts, Support Log, Disruptions and Rebookings and Post-trip Tasks follow a trip from the first reminder to the welcome-home message. Travel Requirements keeps your own planning notes for 24 destinations, always to be checked against the destination's current rules. Packing and Weather Notes and Departures by Week finish the picture, and the dashboard shows which weeks are at risk.

14 calculators cover document deadlines, passport validity, visa lead time, itinerary days, a readiness score, insurance cover, time zones, connection times, departure checklists, request summaries, disruption costs, packing, time off and a what-if grid. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 ready text messages that open with the details already written in.

This is part five of the Travel Agent suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for a small advisor business to explore first. It supports your planning and does not replace checking the destination's rules.

documents.title: Day-by-day itinerary cover page

Dear {col:trips.client}, this is your itinerary for {col:trips.destination}, from {col:trips.start_date} to {col:trips.end_date}, {col:trips.nights} nights for {col:trips.travellers} travellers.
Your plan has {col:trips.itin_days} days listed. Day 1: {col:trips.day1_activity} in {col:trips.day1_place}. Last day planned: {col:trips.last_activity}.

It rests on {col:trips.bookings_n} bookings. Please check every name, date and time against your documents and tell us at once if anything is wrong. Times and places can change; we will tell you if they do.
Your advisor is {col:trips.advisor}.

documents.title: Travel requirements summary for a destination

Passport: we plan for a passport valid for {col:requirements.passport_months} months after the return date. Visa or entry permit: we allow {col:requirements.visa_days} days for any application, so documents are needed {col:requirements.lead_days} days before travel.
Health: {col:requirements.vaccination_note}. Insurance: {col:requirements.insurance_advice}. Forms: {col:requirements.entry_forms}.
This is a planning summary reviewed on {col:requirements.reviewed_on}. Entry, passport and visa rules change: always check the destination's current rules from an official source before you travel.

documents.title: Document checklist for a client
paragraphs: Document checklist of {set:company}, dated {today}. Trip {col:trips.trip_id} to {col:trips.destination}.

Dear {col:trips.client}, to travel on {col:trips.start_date} we still need {col:trips.docs_missing} documents from you. Please send them as soon as you can and no later than {set:ready_days} days before you leave.

Please check the names on every document match the passports, that each passport is valid for the time the destination asks, and that your insurance covers the whole trip. Check the destination's current rules for passports, visas and health.
Reply with a photo or scan of each item. Your advisor is {col:trips.advisor}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Voucher and confirmation pack cover sheet
paragraphs: Voucher pack of {set:company}, dated {today}. Trip {col:trips.trip_id}.

Dear {col:trips.client}, this pack holds the vouchers, tickets and confirmations for {col:trips.destination}, {col:trips.start_date} to {col:trips.end_date}. It covers {col:trips.bookings_n} bookings; {col:trips.vouchers_open} are still to be sent and will follow.
Please keep a printed copy and a copy on your phone. Show the right voucher at each check-in. If a name or date looks wrong, call us before you travel.
Your advisor is {col:trips.advisor}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Pre-departure briefing sheet

Dear {col:briefings.client}, your briefing for {col:briefings.destination} is on {col:briefings.date}, {col:briefings.days_before} days before you leave. We will go through your itinerary, documents, payments, local contacts and what to do if plans change.
Please bring your questions and your documents. After the briefing we will send the notes and check that you have everything.
Your advisor is {col:briefings.advisor}.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

Local contact: {col:emergency.local_contact}, phone {col:emergency.local_phone}. Hotel: {col:emergency.hotel}. Supplier desk: {col:emergency.desk_phone}.
The destination is {col:emergency.hours_diff} hours from our own time zone. Call us first if plans change, then the local contact. Your advisor can be reached on {col:emergency.advisor_phone}.
In an emergency call the local emergency number first.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

Typical temperatures run from {col:packing.temp_low} to {col:packing.temp_high} degrees, with about {col:packing.rain_days} rain days in a month. {col:packing.note}.
These are planning figures only. Please check a current forecast a few days before you leave, and check your airline baggage allowance.

Dear {col:insurance.client}, your insurer is {col:insurance.insurer}. Cover runs from {col:insurance.cover_start} to {col:insurance.cover_end}, {col:insurance.days_covered} days. Your trip runs from {col:insurance.trip_start} to {col:insurance.trip_end}.
Cover check: {col:insurance.gap_flag}. The premium is {col:insurance.premium}. Please read the policy terms for what is and is not covered, and keep the claim phone number with you.

documents.title: Disruption notice and new plan

Dear {col:disruptions.client}, a disruption affected your trip on {col:disruptions.date}. New plan: {col:disruptions.new_plan}.

The extra cost is {col:disruptions.extra_cost}. The supplier refunded {col:disruptions.supplier_refund}. You pay {col:disruptions.client_pays}. We are sorry for the trouble and will keep helping until you are settled.
documents.note: Sample wording: adapt it to your own practice.

documents.title: Post-trip follow-up letter
paragraphs: Post-trip letter of {set:company}, dated {today}. Trip {col:trips.trip_id}.

Dear {col:trips.client}, welcome home from {col:trips.destination}. We hope your {col:trips.nights} nights went well. We would like to know what you enjoyed, what we could do better and if anything went wrong.
If you were happy, a short review would help us a lot, and we would be glad to plan your next trip. Your advisor is {col:trips.advisor}.

id.If you were happy, a short review would: Jika Anda senang, ulasan singkat akan banyak membantu kami, dan kami akan dengan senang hati merencanakan perjalanan Anda berikutnya. Penasihat Anda adalah {col:trips.advisor}.

id.Log every booking on Bookings and every: Catat setiap pemesanan di Bookings dan setiap dokumen di Dokumen perjalanan. Hari menuju tenggat waktu, hari lebih awal dan pemeriksaan risiko selesai; Keberangkatan berdasarkan minggu menunjukkan minggu mana yang berisiko.
id.Record each traveller on Passport and Vi: Catat setiap wisatawan pada Pemeriksaan paspor dan visa dan setiap kebijakan pada Polis asuransi. Bulan berlaku setelah pengembalian, tanggal pengajuan dan kesenjangan pertanggungan diperiksa untuk Anda.

id.Read the Departure Dashboard and Charts: Baca Dasbor keberangkatan dan Bagan setiap minggu: keberangkatan, dokumen hilang, paspor, visa, voucher, permintaan, kasus dukungan, dan tarif siap pakai.

Vérifiez toujours les règles actuelles de la destination auprès d'une source officielle.

fr.Use the 14 calculators for deadlines, pa: Utilisez les 14 calculateurs pour les délais, les passeports, les visas, les itinéraires, l'état de préparation, l'assurance, les fuseaux horaires, les correspondances, les listes de contrôle, les demandes, les perturbations, l'emballage, les congés et les hypothèses.
fr.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Imprimez 10 feuilles et 10 documents, suivez 10 listes de contrôle et appuyez sur un lien de message pour envoyer un texte avec les détails déjà écrits.

fr.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Toutes les listes déroulantes du classeur. Modifiez un élément ici pour le mettre à jour dans toutes les feuilles.
fr.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Se met à jour à partir de vos feuilles. Changez l’année pour consulter les années précédentes.
fr.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Choisissez dans la cellule jaune ; le reste se remplit automatiquement. Prêt à imprimer.
fr.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Modifiez le texte ici ; les mots entre {accolades} sont remplis à partir de chaque ligne. Les liens se trouvent dans les tableaux.
fr.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Choisissez un dossier : chaque étape reçoit sa date d’échéance. Copiez cette feuille pour chaque nouveau dossier.
fr.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Graphiques actualisés à partir de vos feuilles. Choisissez dans les cellules jaunes pour actualiser les graphiques et les jauges.

es.This is a planning summary reviewed on {: Este es un resumen de planificación revisado el {col:requirements.reviewed_on}. Las reglas de entrada, pasaporte y visa cambian: siempre verifique las reglas actuales del destino de una fuente oficial antes de viajar.

es.Please keep a printed copy and a copy on: Guarde una copia impresa y una copia en su teléfono. Muestra el bono correcto en cada check-in. Si un nombre o una fecha parecen incorrectos, llámenos antes de viajar.

es.The destination is {col:emergency.hours_: El destino está a {col:emergency.hours_diff} horas de nuestra propia zona horaria. Llámenos primero si cambian los planes, luego al contacto local. Puede comunicarse con su asesor en {col:emergency.advisor_phone}.
es.In an emergency call the local emergency: En caso de emergencia, llame primero al número de emergencia local.

es.Dear {col:disruptions.client}, a disrupt: Estimado {col:disruptions.client}, una interrupción afectó su viaje el {col:disruptions.date}. Nuevo plan: {col:disruptions.new_plan}.
es.The extra cost is {col:disruptions.extra: El costo adicional es {col:disruptions.extra_cost}. El proveedor reembolsó {col:disruptions.supplier_refund}. Pagas {col:disruptions.client_pays}. Lamentamos el problema y seguiremos ayudándolo hasta que se haya instalado.

es.Dear {col:trips.client}, welcome home fr: Estimado {col:trips.client}, bienvenido a casa desde {col:trips.destination}. Esperamos que tus {col:trips.nights} noches hayan ido bien. Nos gustaría saber qué disfrutó, qué podríamos hacer mejor y si algo salió mal.
es.If you were happy, a short review would: Si estuvo contento, una breve reseña nos ayudaría mucho y estaremos encantados de planificar su próximo viaje. Tu asesor es {col:trips.advisor}.

es.Check the destination's current visa rul: Consulte las reglas de visa actuales del destino.
es.Follow up each visa application: Seguimiento de cada solicitud de visa
es.Record the visa status on the sheet: Registre el estado de la visa en la hoja.
es.Check the passports one last time: Revisa los pasaportes por última vez.
es.Offer insurance cover to the client: Ofrecer cobertura de seguro al cliente.
es.Record the policy number and insurer: Registre el número de póliza y la aseguradora.
es.Check the cover dates against the trip: Consulta las fechas de cobertura con el viaje.
es.Check the cover amount against the trip: Verifique el monto de la cobertura con el costo del viaje.
es.Send the insurance summary to the client: Enviar el resumen del seguro al cliente
es.Check the claim phone number is with the: Verificar que el teléfono de reclamo esté con el cliente.
es.Check every name, date and time: Consulta cada nombre, fecha y hora.

es.Check names and dates on it: Verifique los nombres y las fechas en él.
es.Confirm the client received it: Confirmar que el cliente lo recibió.

es.Confirm the time with the client: Confirmar la hora con el cliente.

es.Check that the commission is expected: Comprueba que la comisión es la esperada.

es.Update the entry form notes: Actualizar las notas del formulario de inscripción.

es.Open Start and type your company name an: Abra Inicio y escriba el nombre de su empresa y sus propios límites en las celdas amarillas: días antes de la salida para documentos, itinerario, vales e información, meses del pasaporte, horarios de soporte y su zona horaria.
es.Check Team, Clients, Suppliers and Trips: Consulta Equipo, Clientes, Proveedores y Viajes. Contienen las personas, clientes, proveedores y viajes que cada dos hojas busca.
es.Fill Travel Requirements with your own p: Complete Requisitos de viaje con sus propias notas de planificación para cada destino: meses de pasaporte, días para permitir una visa, notas de salud y seguro. Verifique siempre las reglas vigentes del destino de una fuente oficial.
es.Log every booking on Bookings and every: Registra cada reserva en Bookings y cada documento en Documentos de viaje. Días para la fecha límite, días adelantados y el control de riesgo completar; Salidas por semana muestra qué semanas están en riesgo.
es.Record each traveller on Passport and Vi: Registre cada viajero en Controles de pasaportes y visas y cada política en Pólizas de seguro. Los meses de validez después de la devolución, la fecha de caducidad y los intervalos de cobertura se comprueban por usted.
es.Build the plan on Itinerary Days and tra: Cree el plan en Días de itinerario y realice un seguimiento de cada cupón en Vales y billetes electrónicos hasta que llegue al cliente.
es.Keep Pre-departure Tasks, Pre-departure: Mantenga Tareas previas a la salida, Sesiones informativas previas a la salida, Solicitudes especiales y Contactos de emergencia actualizados a medida que se acerca un viaje.
es.Use Support Log and Disruptions and Rebo: Utilice Registro de soporte y Interrupciones y cambios de reserva mientras hay un viaje en curso y Tareas posteriores al viaje cuando el cliente esté en casa.
es.Keep Packing and Weather Notes for the p: Mantenga Notas meteorológicas y de embalaje para los lugares donde más vende y consulte un pronóstico actual antes de enviar uno.
es.Use the 14 calculators for deadlines, pa: Utilice las 14 calculadoras para plazos, pasaportes, visas, itinerarios, preparación, seguros, zonas horarias, conexiones, listas de verificación, solicitudes, interrupciones, embalaje, permisos y qué pasaría si.
es.Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow: Imprima 10 hojas y 10 documentos, siga 10 listas de verificación y toque el enlace de un mensaje para enviar un texto con los detalles ya escritos.
es.Read the Departure Dashboard and Charts: Lee el Panel de salida y Gráficos cada semana: salidas, documentos faltantes, pasaportes, visas, bonos, solicitudes, casos de soporte y tarifa lista.
es.Every drop-down list of this file. Renam: Todas las listas desplegables del archivo. Cambia aquí el nombre de un elemento y se actualizará en todas las hojas.
es.Updates itself from your sheets. Change: Se actualiza con los datos de tus hojas. Cambia el año para consultar años anteriores.
es.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Elige en la celda amarilla; el resto se completa automáticamente. Listo para imprimir.
es.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Edita aquí el texto; las palabras entre {llaves} se completan con los datos de cada fila. Los enlaces están en las tablas.
es.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Elige un registro: cada paso tendrá su fecha límite. Haz una copia de esta hoja para cada caso.
es.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Gráficos actualizados con los datos de tus hojas. Elige en las celdas amarillas y los gráficos e indicadores se actualizarán automáticamente.

de.documents, payment, vouchers and tasks g: Dokumente, Zahlung, Gutscheine und Aufgaben ergeben eine Punktzahl und die Zahl der fehlenden Punkte.
de.a start date and the nights at each stop: Startdatum und Nächte je Station ergeben Daten und Wochentage, und jeder Tag verweist auf seine Buchung.
de.every voucher shows when it arrived, whe: Jeder Gutschein zeigt Eingang, Versand und ob er rechtzeitig ging.
de.cover dates and amount against the trip: Deckungszeitraum und Summe gegen Reisedaten und Kosten zeigen Lücken am Anfang oder Ende.
de.every room, meal, access and celebration: Jeder Wunsch zu Zimmer, Essen, Zugang oder Anlass zeigt, wen Sie gefragt haben, die Antwort und wann nachzufassen ist.
de.each case on the road shows hours to sol: Jeder Fall unterwegs zeigt die Stunden bis zur Lösung gegen Ihr Ziel und welche Fälle noch offen sind.
de.the new plan, the supplier refund and th: Neuer Plan, Lieferantenerstattung und Kundenanteil zeigen die Kosten, die bei der Agentur bleiben.
de.departures by week, documents missing an: Abreisen nach Woche, fehlende Dokumente und Bereitschaftsprüfung stellen gefährdete Reisen nach vorn.

de.Days before departure by which every doc: Tage vor der Abreise, bis zu dem alle Dokumente vorliegen sollten

de.One row per trip: client, destination, d: Eine Zeile pro Reise: Kunde, Ziel, Daten, Status und Berater; Tage bis zur Abreise, offene Dokumente, der fertige Scheck, zu versendende Gutscheine und Reisetage füllen sich selbst aus.
de.One row per planned day: trip, day numbe: Eine Zeile pro geplantem Tag: Reise, Tagesnummer, Datum, Ort, Aktivität und die Buchung dahinter; Der Wochentag wird vom Auftraggeber und vom Lieferanten selbst ausgefüllt.
de.One row per supplier booking: trip, supp: Eine Zeile pro Lieferantenbuchung: Reise, Lieferant, Bestätigung, Reisedaten und Status; Reisetage, Gutscheine verschickt und das Telefon des Lieferanten selbst ausgefüllt.
de.One row per document a client must send: Eine Zeile pro Dokument, das ein Kunde oder Sie senden müssen: Art, Status, Fälligkeitsdatum und Empfangsdatum; Tage vor Ablauf der Frist, Tage früher, der Risikocheck und das Abreisedatum füllen sich von selbst aus.
de.Your own planning notes for 24 destinati: Ihre eigenen Planungsnotizen für 24 Reiseziele: Reisepassmonate, Visatage, Gesundheit, Versicherung und Einreiseformularerinnerungen. Überprüfen Sie immer die aktuellen Regeln. Lead-Tage füllen sich aus.
de.Passport validity and visa status by tra: Gültigkeit des Reisepasses und Visumsstatus des Reisenden
de.One row per traveller check: passport ex: Eine Zeile pro Reisescheck: Ablaufdatum des Reisepasses, Visumstatus und Scheckdatum; Monate, die nach der Rückkehr gültig sind, das letzte sichere Ablaufdatum, das Ablaufdatum des Visums und die Schecks füllen sich automatisch aus.
de.One row per policy: insurer, policy numb: Eine Zeile pro Police: Versicherer, Policennummer, Versicherungsdaten und Prämie; Die abgedeckten Tage, die Reisedaten und ein Lückencheck füllen sich automatisch aus.
de.Vouchers and e-tickets sent to clients: Gutscheine und E-Tickets werden an Kunden verschickt
de.One row per voucher or ticket: booking,: Eine Zeile pro Gutschein oder Ticket: Buchung, Art, Datum des Erhalts vom Lieferanten und Datum, an dem Sie ihn gesendet haben; Tage vor Reiseantritt verschickt und ein Scheck selbst ausgefüllt.
de.Pre-departure tasks by trip: Aufgaben vor der Abreise je nach Reise
de.One row per task before a trip leaves: t: Eine Zeile pro Aufgabe vor Beginn einer Reise: Aufgabe, Fälligkeitsdatum, wem sie gehört und wann sie erledigt wurde; Tage zu spät kommen und eine Aufgabenüberprüfung selbstständig ausfüllen.
de.Pre-departure briefings and notes: Briefings und Notizen vor der Abreise
de.One row per briefing: trip, date, kind a: Eine Zeile pro Briefing: Reise, Datum, Art und Datum, an dem die Notizen verschickt wurden; Tage vor der Abreise werden die Notizen überprüft, der Kunde und das Telefon selbst ausfüllen.
de.Packing and weather notes by destination: Pack- und Wetterhinweise nach Reiseziel und Jahreszeit
de.Typical planning figures for 40 destinat: Typische Planungszahlen für 40 Reiseziel- und Saisonpaare, mit der von Ihnen gesendeten Notiz; Überprüfen Sie zunächst eine aktuelle Prognose. Kleidungstipps, Regentipps und Fahrten zum Ort ergänzen sich von alleine.
de.One row per trip: local contact, hotel,: Eine Zeile pro Reise: lokale Kontakt-, Hotel-, Lieferantenschalter- und Telefonnummern sowie die Zeitzone des Ortes; Die Stundendifferenz füllen der Kunde und das Beratertelefon selbstständig aus.
de.In-trip support cases and time to solve: Supportfälle während der Reise und Zeit zur Lösung
de.One row per case on a trip: issue, actio: Eine Zeile pro Fall auf einer Reise: Problem, Aktion, wer es bearbeitet hat und die Stunde, zu der es geöffnet und geschlossen wurde; Stunden zum Lösen und Ausfüllen einer Zielüberprüfung.
de.One row per disruption: kind, the new pl: Eine Zeile pro Störung: Art, der neue Plan, die zusätzlichen Kosten, was der Lieferant erstattet hat und was der Kunde bezahlt hat; die Kosten für die Agentur tragen und einen Rückforderungsscheck selbst ausfüllen.
